Definition: {to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit}
BiblicalUsage: 1) to have power, rule, domineer, rule over; 1a) (P'al) have power upon or over, rule, fall upon, assault, be ruler; 1b) (Aphel) make ruler
